description: This file defines an interface for search-related operations within a sales management system, including indexing, deletion, keyword search, product search, and service initialization.

classes.name: SearchService
classes.description: Interface defining search operations for product indexing, deletion, keyword search, product search, and service initialization.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Indexes a product for a specific merchant store; called when a product is created or updated.

methods.name: deleteIndex
methods.description: Deletes a product index in the appropriate language, typically called when a product is deleted.

methods.name: searchForKeywords
methods.description: Performs a search for related keywords based on input characters, used for auto-complete functionality.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs a product search based on user input, store, language, and pagination parameters.

methods.name: initService
methods.description: Initializes the search service to prevent lazy initialization issues.
